name: Vet Office
tagline: Clinic schedules, patient records and appointment totals
description: Read the schedule, patient records and appointment totals for a veterinary clinic in Vet Office. Choose a clinic if your account has access to more than one. Each request uses your current clinic permissions and the modules in your subscription. Access is read-only.

prompts.text: Which Vet Office clinics can I access?
Show me today's appointments for the clinic I selected.
How many appointments and distinct patients did this clinic have last week?

apps.name: Vet Office
apps.description: Read schedules, patient records and totals for the selected clinic.
